method: W0 spec-coherence pass, 2026-10-30. Each entry names the medulla row and the call recorded in it.

decisions.decision: R001.2 split into .2.1 Constraint and .2.2 Entailment; proofs live in a new optional DecisionRecord field `uniqueness`, omitted when empty so v1 goldens keep their bytes (no schema_version bump).
Entailment requires uniqueness in both scopes; with no eliminations the second solve serves both scopes.
Renamed RecommendationSafetyV1/SafetyBoundV1 to SafetyBound and siblings; dropped the V1 suffix.
Bounds use Q32 fixed point; the NaN/infinity refusal is unrepresentable and dropped.
Dropped dead AU-HARNESS-R021.4/.6/.7: their bound and provenance checks are this row; evidence persists through DecisionLog Commit of the sealed record.
Replaced dead AU-CONTROL-R006 (usage-informed cost) with its medulla successor R801.
Ties break on component_id ascending.
Approval is required only when the pinned policy sets approval_required, so existing commits keep working.
CandidatePoolV1 renamed CandidatePool.
No medulla successor existed for the experience-record content of dead AU-HARNESS-R022.1/.3; the record and ranking are written into R020.1.1/.2 and the dead IDs removed.
RetrievalProviderBindingV1 renamed RetrievalProviderBinding; execution moved to arbora retrieval.search.
AvailableContextSourceV1/ContextSourceSelectionV1 renamed without suffix.
UNAUTHORIZED applies only to sources the caller named; unnamed invisible sources are never counted (R013 wins).
Admission is a new QuestionKind::PaperAdmission with its own family; the six-hour scheduler stays arbora ARBORA-OPS-R022.2 (live).
The route code is a file route.rs, not a route/ directory, matching the flat eg-numeric decision layout.
Workflow-context shielding and the structured-plan fallback are in-run mechanics; medulla keeps the stage order and the ROUTE_NO_STAGE abstention.
Replaced dead AU-CONTROL-R006 with R801; cost key stays `l5.observed_cost` as in R039.1.
Removed dead SDK-SOURCE-INGEST-R012.2 reference; the consumer moves to SCION-CONNECTOR-CONTROL.
R042.101 and R165 define the same ToolNecessity concept; R165 survives. Dead AU-HARNESS-R018.5/R024.2/.4 references drop with the retired row.
Medulla exposes A2A routing as a Decide question kind; the task-submission handler moves to ARBORA-A2A.
New ontology files are named decision.ttl and decision.shapes.ttl without the -v1 suffix (no version suffixes); this departs from the existing file-name pattern.
Cheaper-index skip is the exact-digest lookup only; no persistent BM25 or graph lookup exists for spans, so those skips stay out of scope.
No SQL-column embedding path exists on main; the gate attaches at source_ingestion.rs::prepare and the profile contract moves to scion-sdk.
R080.2 wires the two producers that exist on main; extractors for the remaining rungs bind when their rows land.
rapid_r088.rs does not exist; the change lives in stat_belief.rs.
ReplayEventV1 renamed ReplayEvent.
Wikidata connector code moves to a new connector repo (CONN-WIKIDATA); medulla keeps only the mapping fixture and SHACL validation.
admit_call_path is absent on origin/main and cannot be enforced on the wire; R116.2 proves the contract by inventory instead of wiring a client-side gate.
Attach point is a new DecisionLog PromoteRule op; no production consensus-to-rule path existed. Invariants are a new RuleInvariant component kind.
The call site is the Rank family on the statistical path (register D R130.3), not conclude.rs; the call is rank_calibrated, not rank.
Replaced the Python test with an L3 journey: Rank adds no client method.
The limit stage runs on the statistical Decide path (stat_decide.rs), where Advisory exists; conclude.rs is the assembly path and is not touched.
Entries enter the statistical Decide path as a typed param; known source digests come from the pinned policy.
Removed dead SDK-SOURCE-INGEST-R600; vendor execution moves to SCION-GOVERNED-WRITEBACK.
R036 root journey test is a new L3 file assemble_tests.rs; AgentAssemble solved records use ResolutionKind::Optimization.
R036.101: dropped the sandboxed-frame rendering clause (not a medulla concern); path discovery is a consumer note.
R036.103-.106: kept as medulla-resident engine persistence (RbacStore, AgentLibraryStore, coordinator); the two-phase direction already landed in R036.102 stays.
R106.1: quorum is strict majority of positions, default fraction 0.5 (knob); conflict rule plurality, tie abstains. Types lose the V1 suffix.
R172: removed all references to the deleted Meristem module and its acceptance tests; acceptance is defined inline by fixtures.

R614: the engine runs no text model. The caller supplies a card summary with model id and prompt digest; classification is nearest-centroid on the existing embedder. Method SemanticEnrich is new (method_11.rs, ingestion domain).
R650: the served method CapabilityDesignate is dropped; designation is the Decide kind CapabilityDesignation of R172 and R650 supplies the descriptor and closure projection it returns.
R814.7: UQL text follows the pipeline grammar seen in tests (MATCH ... |> RETURN); the served test must parse it, and the lane corrects row and test together if the grammar differs.
R128 root keeps the harness_config family in medulla; run-time application is a harness obligation recorded as a consumer note.
Thresholds become knobs harness.* (R179); tenant override flows through the pinned DecisionPolicy, not a separate override path.
Profile resolved via search_components kind filter (verified path in candidates.rs); ablation and upper-bound facts read from graph nodes so no new request fields are needed.
Reviewer cited smallest_covering_subset (greedy); stat_tool_subset.rs already uses the exact solver (R056.2.2), so the family reuses solved_covering_subset to keep one selector.
required_capabilities added as an optional additive field on HarnessConfigRequestBody.
The old specialized-or_else chain is gone (R001.101.2), so routing is one registry arm instead of a match beside tool_subset_outcome.
Why-not for non-component parts is encoded as Definition premises because WhyNot is keyed by component and slot.
The family stores HarnessConfigEvaluationEvidence in StatisticalInputs.harness_evaluation at seal time; that field exists on main.
Rollup only; the two children carry the work.
Both unit tests exist at harness_config.rs and are bound by this row.
Wording no longer says refuse all attached evidence; after R128.13.2.1 only evidence that fails re-derivation refuses. The existing test still holds.
Limits become knobs; benchmark clause moves to the R178 nightly suite (D-3); byte ceiling capped at the 16 MiB frame limit.
Rollup only.
Replay mirrors the existing replay_harness_contrast pattern in stat_replay.rs.
Limits become knobs; benchmark clause moves to the R178 nightly suite (D-3).
Benchmark clause is the nightly group decide/harness_config.
Ledger is an ingest/read surface, not a Decide family; its stage is stated as outside the pipeline.
One served method Usage{op} (append, put_price, read) follows the DecisionLog{op} pattern; read is the 'UsageRead' of R801.7.
UsageRecord gains recorded_at_ms (needed for price-at-record-time) and child_id/operation (partition keys for R158); prices use u64 micro-units per Mtok to avoid floats.
Currency is one catalog currency per tenant; no currency field.

Storage is a redb ledger transaction in server/persistence (pattern: decision_jobs.rs), replacing the unverifiable 'MutationBatch' and 'eg-tsdb buckets' wording; day buckets live in the same transaction so append and rollup stay atomic.
Cost is None (unknown) when no price applies; routing must abstain naming the fact (R039.1).
Negative counts arrive only through the wire decoder, so the code is raised there.
Golden file location fixed at tests/golden/usage_cost_rollup.json.
Benchmark moves to the nightly suite (D-3); budgets kept as written (D-4).
Read is op 'read' of the Usage method; the old name UsageRead is retained only as the operation's meaning.
Trace persistence reuses the existing ReceiptNode and apply_receipt_rows path; the produced link comes from eg_durable::project.
Split the review's R133.5 into premises (R133.5) and trace write (new R133.8).
RunTraceRecord gains model_id; R165 counts tool use from its steps.
Defaults are Tunable knobs; ceilings are Fixed because they bound security resources.
Routing is a registry arm; the cited stat_decide.rs line numbers are dropped.
A missing task class answers the defaults as an Advisory with a Claim premise instead of an Abstained outcome, because an abstention would carry no quota values.
Trace-write evidence moved to R133.8.
Benchmark clause is the nightly group decide/runtime_quota.
Recursive trace nodes ride the existing terminal receipt-node path; the read is one typed method TraceCritique with a scope split for protected fields.
Version suffixes dropped (RecursiveTraceNode, TraceCritiqueQuery).
Three package/mode decisions get their own question kinds (context_package, recursion_mode) instead of one overloaded context_budget kind; one term per concept.
The context policy of harness_config is not an input here; the over-window fraction is a knob.
Missing window uses the knob default with a Claim premise instead of abstaining.
Missing window uses the knob default, fixing the contradictory 'abstain with the default' wording.
Benchmark clause is the nightly group decide/context_budget.
Values are integer micro-units so no float or rounding rule is needed at solve time.
Package records live in a new context_package.rs, not in context_budget.rs, to keep both files small.
The review rated this row READY; the sentence 'round_ties_even' is dropped because values are already integer micro-units.
Latency term uses milliseconds and tokens per second, divided by 1000.
The package arrives as a new typed param, with declared candidates carrying only the ids, so stages 1 and 2 still run.
Stale means the graph node revision or digest differs; the node properties are read through the tenant-filtered GraphView.
The consumer contract AU-CONTEXT-R004 is dead; the consumer side is a harness obligation recorded as a consumer note.
Cross-repository acceptance dropped; the consumer is a consumer note.
Threshold rule is a policy constraint at stage 3, not a ladder rung; the selected_rung output of the draft is dropped.
Defaults 65536 bytes and 50000 nodes come from the review.
Medulla keeps the verdict; the held-out evaluator and the replacement point are harness obligations recorded as consumer notes.
AU-HARNESS references removed.
R137.101 retires into this row.
Admission is the medulla share; output validation against the signature is a harness obligation recorded as a consumer note.
R137.102 retires into this row; AU-HARNESS references removed.
Recommended option applied: bands map to fractions of remaining tokens (R137.16 decision); the band is a measured task-class fact, never a request claim.
Medulla owns relevance selection; the run loop applies the version and records the event (consumer note).
AU-HARNESS references removed.
D-5: retire R137.101 into R137.14.
D-5: retire R137.102 into R137.15.

Option 1 applied: registered mode table, selection by request mode_id (D R148.2). The ConfigReplayReceipt draft type is dropped; the sealed record inputs_digest plus the config digest already bind the replay.
Settings are a closed scalar map so the digest is canonical and hashable.
KnobValue has no text type, so the default-mode knob holds the mode ordinal.
Applying the config is a harness obligation (consumer note 9).
A changed config between decision and invocation is detected when the caller re-asks with expected_config_digest.
Loader acceptance is Meristem-side and is not recorded here.
Loader step dropped to a consumer note.
Entry is Decide (evaluate-only, per run), not DecisionEval; error observations are the R801 ledger outcomes, partitioned by child_id and operation.
Budget is echoed, not changed, by the rule.
Decision R158.2 applied: ladder rule, model one tier up and width minus one at high error; width plus one up to the host ceiling at low error.
Replaces the stat_jobs.rs seam, which holds import lines and no routing.
Necessity is computed from stored RunTrace nodes (R133), which is why RunTraceRecord carries model_id and step kinds.
Decision R165.2 applied: necessity is the success-rate difference with versus without the tool, abstaining below 30 samples per arm.
Staleness applies to the newest counted run because the measure is computed at read time.
The link to the model call is a premise, so Decide writes nothing.
Threshold defaults 3 and 5 become knobs concentration.min_shipped and concentration.window_rounds.
Shape goes into the existing harness-v1.shapes.ttl rather than a new file; the policy node is the single threshold source.
Benchmark clause moves to the nightly suite (D-3); the 2 ms budget stays on the kernel sub-benchmark.
Tool relevance returns a ranked tool list and covering subset, not a TaskPlanProposal: a plan tool step needs call arguments the engine does not hold.
A skill step names its skill in a typed `assignee` field instead of in `prompt`; the policy revision bump covers the change.
QuestionKind::ToolRelevance moves from R134.1 to R134.110.1, which owns that family.
Callers supply no relevance scores: the tool index computes them (R134.110.2), so R134.2 no longer takes a caller `relevance` field.
Specialist routing uses caller-declared specialist scores; Medulla holds no model, so decomposition takes typed subtasks from the harness.
Skill ranking authority is Medulla (brief R134.9); the AU-HARNESS/AU-CONTEXT conflict is closed by removing both references.
Horizon partition rule is dependency-layer based; credit accounting is one fixed identity, not a tunable formula.
AggregateFanout/v1 becomes a `Decide` question kind `FanoutAggregate`: the operator application is a verdict, so no new Method variant is needed.
The coordinator is the existing output task, so the plan gains only `final_artifact`, not a second `coordinator_id`.
Reuse the candidate-local BM25 kernel instead of a new inverted index: one lexical scorer, and visibility holds by construction.
Removed dead AU-BOUNDARY references; kept the live ARBORA-RELEASE and MERISTEM-HARNESS-CYCLE references.
R134.751 stays as the scale proof at the catalog cap; R134.110.6 is the functional journey. Both use knob tool_subset.max_tools (D-6).
Producer/consumer identity digests of R135.9 are dropped: the receipt digest and the verifier policy digest already bind both sides.
Semantic reuse key and provenance receipt follow the closure text; receipts split into child R135.8.1 to keep each row one unit.
Dropped ComparativeAnalysisEvidence and ComparativeAnalysisRefusal as separate types: premises are PremiseRef and refusals are registered codes (R010.100).
Used Q32 QuantisedValue for score and importance instead of f64, so replay stays deterministic.
Importance thresholds, synthesis batch and ceiling cap are knobs; importance is already normalised or the request refuses.
Carrier for the family body is a new TypedValue variant and the answer is StatisticalOutcome::Answered with FamilyAnswer; the first family PR adds the variant.
Meristem consumer and receipt moved to MERISTEM-RUN; Medulla keeps plan, premises and digest.
Meristem consumer and receipt moved to MERISTEM-RUN; Medulla keeps plan, premises and digest.

Per R135.8 decision: medulla compiles only typed drafts; the harness extracts the draft from prose. No Method::CompileSkillWorkflow is added: the compile is a Decide question and the store reuses CompiledProgram and ProgramLookup.
Dependency on R135.1 and R135.3 so one program store exists.
Replaced the proposed RecordPathOutcome write op with the existing DecisionLog Evaluate path and aggregate_log; path_id is the option id.
Moved the R039 routing wording out: this root is its own PathPreference question and does not extend connector-competency R039.

Per register: comparison is the set difference of planned versus wired call sites; wired means the attach file is a support path of an existing view container. Reused derive_architecture_view; no second derivation.
R171 overlaps EG-CQ-ORCH-R010.7; this root owns the Decide question and R010.7's TaskPlan gate calls the same function. Request type PlanningAdmissionRequest replaces PlanAdmissionV1.
Merge rule: max score per component id, ties by id; skills join tools through shared capabilities in the same pack; agents via orchestrationUsesTool.
Test file renamed load_set.rs -> load_set_tests.rs to match the stat_tests convention; refusal codes prefixed with the family (LOAD_SET_*).

Conditions derive from cp:providesCapability and cp:operatesOn (no precondition property exists); step tool joins through the step's needsSkill skill and shared capabilities; success rate source is DecisionLog aggregate.
Search arena stays with the caller: Decide takes a 64-node frontier summary plus a spent-budget ledger, because the request cap is 64 KiB and 64 candidates.

Split: reward decomposition and curriculum promotion are two question kinds; the subgoal hierarchy is produced by the harness and only validated here. Dynamic sampling reduced to a saturation check on the trajectory reward.

Fan-out width, drift and corrigibility are choices and stay in medulla; the harness only applies them. Approval is enforced by arbora, not by a medulla approval fact. Self-reported outcomes are the existing label refusal.

Module name verify clashed with solve/verify; kernels live in eg-numeric decision/trajectory_join.rs and step_verify.rs. Adversarial probes reuse ProbeVerdict of R138; the join, verdict and admission are choices and stay in medulla.
Overstory comparison panel text dropped from R100.100: no live consumer spec exists (WEBUI-* is cut), so no move was emitted.
R100.1 mapping (register): ok is positive, error or correction is hard negative, key (event_id, source_revision). Added: latest event time wins per (record, evidence); ties go negative.
R100.1 entry corrected from DecisionFit to DecisionLog Learn FitAdapter, because adapter fits run there (stat_adapter.rs).
R100.100 split into two features (ranking evaluation .1/.2, context search .3/.4) per review. Ranking metric value is stored as integer parts per million (half to even) to stay deterministic.
Context search matches exact normalized n-grams (no case folding) so original-byte offsets stay exact; case folding is out of scope.
R100.101 split into topic coverage, Brier score and wiring per review. Brier uses fixed-point parts per million with q rounded half to even before squaring, so the score is exact in 128-bit integers.

D-2: R145.* retired into R141.100. MemoryRecord does not exist on origin/main in crates/eg-types/src/memory.rs (it holds ConversationRecord, ProjectRules, RetentionPolicy, ContextBudget, MemoryClass). Rows cite MemoryRecord as defined by R617.1 (g07).

Receipt gate lands on Consolidate (new required field admit_receipt_digests) and on SyncMemorySnapshot (EG-DURABLE-KERNEL-R085.4 calls the same function); Reinforce and DecayMemories are salience-only and exempt.
SyncMemorySnapshot, ReadMemorySnapshot and ListMemorySnapshots are not in the code on origin/main; they are specified in EG-DURABLE-KERNEL-R085. Rows depend on those IDs.
R059 outcome-aggregate fidelity and R128 context elision are not substitutes; kept as the original row stated.

R144.1 (register): typed ops RawRead, CorpusScan, VerifySpan over medulla-stored Document nodes only. Served as a new read method IndexlessRetrieve instead of changing the raw-row result of UnifiedQuery, so the cost report has a typed home.
Budget type is named IndexlessBudget because eg_plan::budget::Budget already exists for plan execution and means something else.
ARBORA forwarding of caller budgets needs no row: arbora serves the new method automatically as eg.*.
Ranking is served as a Decide Rank variant (param distilled_scorer) instead of a UnifiedQuery change, so the choice is a sealed record. Uploads reuse LearningWrite; no new Method.
planning.rs:424 cited by the old row is unrelated; dropped.
Search state uses the R085.9 body (four arrays) instead of the old digest-only SearchState struct, so there is one store and one record model. Digests are derived at read time.
A separate SaveSearchState operation is not added: SyncMemorySnapshot compare-and-set already provides versioning (anti-sprawl).
R150.2 staleness: 7 d stale and 14 d archived (register). EG-DURABLE-KERNEL-R085.10 says 30 d; its text must follow these knobs.
Conflicting notes (same input digest, different output digest) are flagged and never applied automatically, matching R085.10's rule that unresolved content is not used implicitly.
Capture requires a successful RunOutcome receipt (R100.102) for the note's run id.
D-2/R151.3: medulla applies the penalty in the fit path; consolidation moved out of R151 to R651.
Split R152: medulla returns a cited fact bundle (new read ContextFacts); prose rendering, citation mapping and unrenderable-fact refusal moved to MERISTEM-RUN.
Dead context-compiler reference removed; rendering is a harness obligation recorded as a consumer note.
R153.3/.6: medulla keeps the TOC record and ReadSpan; arbora listing and meristem exploration consumers moved out.
Method::RetrievalContextSearch does not exist on main; the served proof uses the new ReadSpan read.
D-2/R154: the target store is the one MemoryRecord model of R651; no separate operator knobs.
R154.3 and R154.5 retired per register.
D-2/R155: Episode groups MemoryRecord ids; no second memory record type.
Transcript projection is owned by R617.2/R617.3; R155 consumes it.
R164.3: history source is a new Learn write RecordBranchOutcome; Meristem binding and SkillGraphPipeline extension moved to MERISTEM-RUN.
Contradiction is defined as a first-half versus second-half success-rate gap above 0.5.
R174 family: refusal codes are upper-snake and registered in the retrieval-learning REFUSALS table; version suffixes dropped from every type.
Decide writes nothing (AD-4), so the encoder fit is a Learn write (new child R175.8).
V1 names in recommend.rs renamed in new child R175.7.
D-2/R617: chat logs, rules and notes all store as MemoryRecord; R617.2 split into five slices (.2 and .2.1 to .2.4).
D-2/R651.3: keep Consolidate, Reinforce and DecayMemories; add only MemoryRemember, MemoryRecall and MemoryExport. Consolidation planning is a field of MemoryRecall.
R651.1: no new crate file in eg-epistemic; the types extend the existing crates/eg-types/src/memory.rs.
Term fix: 'salience' retired in favour of the existing node property and field 'importance'.
AU-HARNESS-R022.2 had no medulla successor; its consolidation threshold is a choice, so new child R059.2 holds it.
Transferability reuses the R059 independent-outcome aggregate; no parallel evaluation store.
`BackboneSkillEvaluation` becomes `BackboneBinding` on the existing evaluation record; no version suffix.
R654 `TransferScore` retires into `TransferEstimate` here (one term per concept).
The scalar reliability wire fields change in one release with no compatibility alias (hard cutover); the plan note asking for compatibility is superseded.
Sparse-pool threshold is the existing statistical policy `min_support` (10), now `knob reputation.min_support`.
AU-HARNESS-R021.3/.6/.7 (judge versus outcome divergence gate) had no medulla successor; new child R136.103 holds it.
R136.100 retires into R161; R136.101 and R136.102 become one new kind `CriterionReview`.
R136.100 restates R161 (failed-run trace, fix, regression test, paired revision receipts); R161 survives.
AU-HARNESS-R004.1, R019.9 and R019.10 content (correction proposal, measured lift, engine-owned admission) is covered by R161.
AU-HARNESS-R021.1 verdict `promote/hold/refuse` maps onto `PromotionVerdict` from R805.7; the review returns `hold` on regression.
Applied R654.1 register: skill revisions reuse R805/R810 types; `PromotionVerdict` lives in R805.7, `TransferScore` retires into R059.1 `TransferEstimate`.
R654.6 hot-path numbers move to the nightly suite (D-3); the bench is a `decide/skill_evolution` group in `benches/decide_budgets.rs`, not an `eg-epistemic` bench.
AD-10 lifecycle owner is R805: types in `crates/eg-types/src/decision/promotion.rs`, kernels in `crates/eg-numeric/src/decision/promotion.rs`.
Champion pointers reuse the governed pointer store (`stat_pointer.rs`) and `DecisionLog` `MovePointer`; the program graph pointer `ProgramActiveRevision` retires (R805.8).
Promotion knobs are `Fixed`: the evolution engine must not tune its own promotion gate.
Three receipt producers map into one `HeldOutEvidence`: `DecisionEvalReceipt` (heads), program job evidence (programs, prompts, skills), `PolicyEvaluation` (knob sets, model policies).
`OptimizationResult.promoted` is replaced by `stage`; the job never moves a champion (hard cutover).
Program refusal codes live in new `crates/eg-types/src/decision/program.rs` so the R010.100 uniqueness test reaches them.
R179.3 says R811 receipts score knob-set revisions, so `PolicyEvaluation` generalizes from model-policy versions to `RevisionSubject` (wire change, hard cutover).
Applied register: one `GraderKind` with five kinds; it lives in eg-types so `PolicyEvaluation` and `HeldOutEvidence` share it.
Probe verdict rides in StatisticalOutcome::Advisory as a one-hot score over the labels resisted, compromised, inconclusive; no new outcome variant.
Admission is a Decide family (new QuestionKind GeneratedCodeAdmission); materialization authority stays in arbora's governed write path.
Receipt cases travel as Declared options because TypedValue has no list-of-records variant.
Changeset review is a Decide family; findings arrive as Declared options; arbora is the producer.
Claims are served by one Method::Claims with an op enum, following the DecisionLog shape; wire types in eg-types, kernels in eg-epistemic.
Seal digest is SHA-256 (D-5), not blake3.
LoopInstance.state is a string validated against loop_statechart_def(); no second LoopStatus enum.
Meristem consumer clauses (K dispatch, projection, breadth receipts, comparison execution) became consumer notes.
Dropped the python L4 file: the root adds no client method, so L3 is the served proof.
Score is a weighted integer sum in micro-units, so replay is byte-stable.
Dropped version suffix from TrajectoryBudgetDecision.
Projection order comes from the engine so Meristem only applies it.
Outcome-to-breadth mapping is a knob table: failure widens, success narrows.
Policy id has no version suffix: pairwise_copeland, revision 1.
Dead AU reference removed; comparison execution is a consumer note.
Dropped version suffix; types are LocalCertificationAttestation.
Admission knobs are Fixed: delegation admission is a policy question.
Publication knobs are Fixed: publication is a policy and irreversible action.
Admission rides Decide with a new CorrectionAdmission kind, because no ProposeCorrection method exists.
Kept the projection decision and its record in medulla; workspace construction is a consumer note.
Registry persistence uses tenant graph nodes, matching the graph-stored workflows of R135.8.
Compatibility is an additive-only schema diff (D register R167.2).
Agent lifecycle record reuses AgentLibraryLifecycle; run-time states are harness consumer notes.
Stop rule is a choice, so it stays in medulla; grading and instruction derivation are consumer notes.
The fallback is a choice, so it stays in medulla; the durable task store and the coordinator move to ARBORA-OPS.
